s: After her husband and sons die in Moab, Naomi returns to Bethlehem. Her daughter-in-law Ruth refuses to leave her: your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz, a relative of Naomi's husband, who treats her with kindness.
Following Naomi's advice, Ruth asks Boaz at night to take her under his protection as a near kinsman.
Boaz marries Ruth. Their son Obed is the grandfather of King David.

1: A foreign woman chooses Israel's God and stays faithful to her mother-in-law. She becomes the great-grandmother of David and an ancestor of Jesus.
